zh.title: 颱風白海豚逼近 華航與星宇調整8月6日起沖繩航班
zh.summary: 受中度颱風白海豚影響，中華航空與星宇航空宣布調整2026年8月6日至8日的往返沖繩航班。其中，華航在此期間共取消14架次航班，並對部分航班進行時間調整或放大機型；星宇航空則於8月6日取消2架次，且8月7日往返沖繩的航班全數取消。
body: 受中度颱風白海豚移動影響，中華航空與星宇航空於2026年8月5日宣布調整8月6日至8日期間往返沖繩之航班。
中華航空表示，自8月6日至8日共有14架次往返沖繩航班取消，包含6日CI122/CI123，7日CI120/CI121、CI122/CI123、CI310/CI311、CI2132/CI2133、CI132/CI133，以及8日CI310/CI311。此外，華航6日部分航班將提前或放大機型執飛，8日部分航班則將延後。
星宇航空則於8月6日取消台中往返沖繩JX312/JX313，其餘四架次沖繩航班（JX870、JX871、JX302、JX303）將提前起飛。8月7日台灣往返沖繩航班也將全數取消。

en.title: Typhoon White Dolphin Prompts China Airlines and STARLUX Flight Adjustments to Okinawa
en.summary: Due to the approach of Typhoon White Dolphin, China Airlines and STARLUX Airlines have announced flight adjustments for their routes between Taiwan and Okinawa from August 6 to 8, 2026. China Airlines will cancel 14 flights and adjust other schedules, including upgrading some flights to larger aircraft. Meanwhile, STARLUX Airlines will cancel two flights on August 6 and advance the departure times of four others, followed by the cancellation of all its Taiwan-Okinawa flights scheduled for August 7.
body: Due to the movement of Typhoon White Dolphin, China Airlines and STARLUX Airlines announced flight adjustments for their routes between Taiwan and Okinawa from August 6 to 8, 2026.

China Airlines has cancelled 14 flights scheduled between August 6 and 8. These include Taoyuan-Okinawa flights CI122/CI123 on August 6, as well as CI120/CI121 and CI122/CI123 on August 7. It also includes Taichung-Okinawa flights CI310/CI311 on August 7 and 8, and Kaohsiung-Okinawa flights CI2132/CI2133 and CI132/CI133 on August 7. Some flights on August 6 will be advanced or upgraded, while some on August 8 will be delayed.

STARLUX Airlines will cancel JX312/JX313 between Taichung and Okinawa on August 6, while four other flights (JX870, JX871, JX302, and JX303) on August 6 will depart early. Furthermore, all STARLUX flights between Taiwan and Okinawa on August 7 are cancelled.

zh.title: 華航免費直飛福岡 協助慈濟運送熊本震災避難隔屏
zh.summary: 慈濟基金會於8月4日表示，為支援日本熊本強震避難所需求並降低染疫風險，緊急調度200頂福慧隔屏至桃園八德倉儲打包，並由中華航空於當日下午免費協助直飛運送至日本福岡機場，投入災區救援。首批援助物資已於8月3日抵達熊本八代市物資中心。
body: 慈濟基金會於8月4日表示，為因應日本熊本地震後的避難所需求，緊急調度200頂福慧隔屏前往桃園八德倉儲進行打包作業，並預計於當日下午由中華航空免費協助直飛運送至日本福岡機場，以投入災區的後續救援工作。
日本熊本縣於7月28日下午發生規模7.1強烈地震，避難所隨後於8月2日出現COVID-19確診個案。慈濟指出，首批援助的148張福慧床與40頂隔屏已於8月3日運抵熊本八代市緊急救援物資中心，後續將與當地討論設置地點，以降低避難所的染疫風險並保障災民隱私。

en.title: China Airlines Airlifts Relief Partitions to Fukuoka for Kumamoto Earthquake Relief
en.summary: The Tzu Chi Foundation announced on August 4 that China Airlines provided free direct flight assistance to airlift 200 folding relief partitions to Fukuoka Airport, supporting shelter operations following a magnitude 7.1 earthquake in Kumamoto, Japan. The disaster hit Kumamoto on July 28, causing crowding in evacuation shelters where a COVID-19 infection was subsequently reported on August 2. An initial batch of 148 folding beds and 40 partitions previously arrived at the Yatsushiro emergency relief supply center on August 3. The newly dispatched partitions were gathered and packed at a Taoyuan warehouse before being flown directly to Japan to reduce infection risks in disaster shelters.
body: The Tzu Chi Foundation stated on August 4 that it urgently dispatched 200 folding partitions to a warehouse in Bade, Taoyuan for packing. China Airlines provided free direct flight assistance on the afternoon of August 4 to transport the relief supplies directly to Fukuoka Airport in Japan to support ongoing relief operations following a recent earthquake in Kumamoto.

A magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck Kumamoto Prefecture on the afternoon of July 28, leading to overcrowded conditions in evacuation centers where a COVID-19 case was identified on August 2. Tzu Chi noted that an initial shipment of 148 folding beds and 40 partitions arrived at the emergency relief supply center in Yatsushiro, Kumamoto on August 3, aimed at improving privacy and reducing infection risks for displaced residents.
